_source: Select Group project page, read 17 September 2026 (manifest: data/media/_sources/peninsula_five.json).
_assets_from: Images published openly on that page. Brochure and floor plans are behind an enquiry form and were NOT fetched.
_override_note: Hero is the waterfront render showing the full tower elevation. The file named 'BEDROOM2_05' is a living and dining room and is NOT used; the bedroom is BEDROOM_06, which is one.  Every one of these was identified from a scout's record of what the image ACTUALLY SHOWS, after opening it - not from its filename. Select mislabels rooms often enough that the name is treated as a hint and never as evidence.
image_note: Images are published by Select Group, the developer, on its own project page, and are reproduced here for a buyer considering the building. They are computer renders showing the developer's intended specification — they are not photographs of any particular apartment, and the finish of an individual unit may differ. Ask to view before relying on them.
caveats: Select Group publishes no apartment layouts openly for this building — its floor plans sit behind an enquiry form, which we do not fill in. Ask and we will request the plan for a specific unit.
